title: Kenyan-Style Dumplings with Warm German Sauce
description: A fusion dish bringing together the hearty flavors of Germany and the spices of Kenya, served with a warm and comforting sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the dumplings according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook the german sausage over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the german beer to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
To assemble the dish, place a cooked dumpling on a plate and spoon some of the warm german sauce over the top.
